timeline.summary: Allcargo Logistics reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹514 Cr and net profit of ₹20 Cr with an unmodified auditor opinion.
Allcargo Logistics announced consolidated financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26, posting a 41% YoY increase in Q4 EBITDA.
Allcargo Logistics approved the acquisition of a 25% stake in group entity Allcargo Group Services for approximately ₹3.54 lakh to streamline shared service costs.
Allcargo Logistics reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹514 Cr and EBITDA of ₹60 Cr.
Allcargo Logistics Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on May 15, 2026, at 3:30 PM (IST) via www.allcargologistics.com/investor.
Allcargo Logistics reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹514 Cr and FY26 EBITDA of ₹233 Cr, noting expected listing of Allcargo Global within a month.
Shareholders approved Mr. Sivaraman Narayanaswami’s reappointment as Independent Director via postal ballot on May 27, 2026, with requisite majority.
Allcargo Logistics held its 33rd AGM on September 16, 2026, reporting FY26 revenue of ₹2,058 Cr and EBITDA of ₹233 Cr, up 16% YoY, and reaffirming its Vision 2030 roadmap.
Allcargo Logistics announced receipt of SEBI order granting exemption to Shashi Kiran Shetty Family Trust for acquiring a 34.41% promoter stake.
Allcargo Logistics migrated its finance and procurement operations to Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications across 700 units.
